notes: Latest price is $212/MWh. We compare that to the last 7 days to decide if it’s “normal”, “elevated”, or a “spike”.
Grid Stress is a simple, conservative label based on: (1) prices vs the last 7 days, (2) how unusually high demand is, and (3) outages being unusually high.
Demand right now is 54714 MW. “Watch” starts when demand is above the 90th percentile of the last 7 days.
System Lambda (a real-time marginal cost signal) is 203. Very high lambda can indicate tight conditions.
